name: MMIX
steps: Do the one-time tasks: follow on X, join Discord, join Telegram.
Before 23 November 2026, 21:00 UTC, like, repost and comment on the 17 November announcement for the 200 points.
Give a wallet address. The form asks for "The wallet that will mint on Ethereum. Use one you control, not an exchange address." You type the address in; a new, empty wallet is the safer choice.
Go back to the hub. The whitelist task checks itself and can take up to a day to show the 1.1x multiplier. Do it before 25 November 2026, 21:00 UTC.
Check in each day and submit one X post a week if you want to keep adding points.
what: MMIX has no token yet. Its free points hub and a whitelist for 3,000 free-mint Districts NFTs are open until 26 November. Steps and risks.
behind: No person is named anywhere on the official pages. The operator is "the MMIX Foundation, a private interest foundation registered in the Republic of Panama", with no registry number or address given, and the disclaimers state that "it is not licensed or regulated as a financial services provider in any jurisdiction." We found no investor, funding round or news coverage. The home page shows partner
costs: Everything open today is free. No page we read asks for a deposit, a purchase or a payment. The Districts mint is described as free, but it is on Ethereum, so expect to pay gas when it happens. MMIX has not said how much or when. The real price is your accounts. The program asks for your X account, follows, a like, a reply, a quote post, weekly posts, Discord and Telegram joins and a wallet addres
risks: Age: "You must be at least 18 years old to use the Service." No list of excluded countries is published. The terms shut out people under sanctions and in fully sanctioned countries, and say access can be restricted from any jurisdiction.
